title: A seat for JSP's 'school bag': Why Kishor's Bankipur win is a warning for BJP, RJD
content: Prashant Kishor achieved a remarkable victory in the Bankipur byelection, effectively breaking the BJP's three-decade dominance on the assembly seat. This triumph represents Kishor's resurgence in politics following his party's prior electoral drubbing in the state. He leveraged this win to critique Bihar's chief minister and emphasize the need for development. The outcome comes as an embarrassment for the current government's leadership.

title: India-origin cricketer Reddy handed 8-year ban by ICC for corruption
content: USA cricketer Bodugum Akhilesh Reddy has been banned from all cricket for eight years after an ICC tribunal found him guilty of three Anti-Corruption Code breaches linked to the 2025 Abu Dhabi T10. He was found to have attempted match-fixing, encouraged a teammate to participate, and deleted evidence during the investigation. His ban is effective from November 21, 2025.

title: Indian-American CEO wanted a new country, then a real nation got in the way
content: Indian-American tech founder Balaji Srinivasan left Silicon Valley to build a new country from scratch, opening his Network School inside Forest City, a $100 billion Chinese-built ghost development in Malaysia's Johor. Two years and hundreds of residents later, local authorities ordered it shut over licensing irregularities, following a separate investigation into Israeli passports on campus. Within hours, the Network State author signed a deal to reopen in Kazakhstan.

title: World Cup rights row: Wales withdraw support for Infantino's re-election bid
content: The Football Association of Wales (FAW) said it will no longer back Infantino's re-election campaign for the 2027-2031 term, following concerns over the failed investment plan.

title: Jeff Bezos warns Mamdani on NYC taxes, slams wasteful spending
content: Jeff Bezos commented on New York City's proposed pied-à-terre tax, calling it a fine thing for the city. He cautioned against aggressive tax increases, which could deter tourism and economic competitiveness. Bezos rejected targeting individuals like Ken Griffin, calling it a villain strategy. He argued that government spending inefficiencies are a greater concern than taxation levels. Bezos previously criticized New York City's public school spending and economic policies.

title: Arshdeep Singh named in North Zone squad for Duleep Trophy; Wadhawan to lead
content: Arshdeep, who is a regular in India's white-ball teams, was part of the Test squad during the 2025 tour of England but did not make his Test debut because of injury and team combination issues.

title: World’s third-smallest country changes name from Nauru to Naoero
content: Around 50,000 mattresses are thrown away every day in the United States, but more than 80 per cent of the materials inside them can be recycled. Instead, most end up in landfills, where they take up space and damage waste-handling equipment. The article explains why mattress recycling remains limited, what research says about mattress chemicals, and how some US states have successfully introduced recycling programmes.

title: UK dad pays £10 airport fees but still gets two £100 fines
content: Kevin Smith initially paid ten pounds for two airport drop-offs but was unexpectedly hit with two parking fines totaling two hundred pounds. These fines were charged for completing the payment within the drop-off zone. After appealing, APCOA cancelled one fine, but Mr. Smith is still contesting the second and is prepared to pursue it further if needed.

title: Lauren Sanchez worked at waterpark; 40 years later, she takes luxurious ocean trips
content: Lauren Sanchez's career evolved from a teenage waterpark job to ocean conservation leadership. She recently explored the Galápagos Islands, highlighting shark importance. The Bezos Earth Fund supports significant marine conservation projects in the region. These initiatives protect vast ocean areas and numerous marine species. Sanchez's work now focuses on protecting vital ocean ecosystems.

title: Nanaji Deshmukh Awas Yojana: How workers can avail Rs 1.6 lakh housing aid
content: In Gujarat, registered construction workers have the opportunity to benefit from financial support aimed at housing through the Shree Nanaji Deshmukh Awas Yojana. To qualify, applicants must have been registered with the welfare board for a minimum of two years. Following the acquisition of an e-Nirman Card and house allotment, they can submit their applications. Those approved will receive ₹1.6 lakh to assist in home ownership.

title: Here's how Michael Phelps built his $100 million fortune in 2026
content: Michael Phelps turned his legendary Olympic achievements into a multi-million dollar empire. By securing high-value endorsements from renowned brands post-retirement, he also channeled his success into impactful ventures. His establishment of a foundation showcases his commitment to youth education in swimming and healthy living. Additionally, Phelps's investment in the mental health platform shows his suppport for emotional wellness.

title: Here's how Russell Wilson's family stood by him through every challenge
content: The star QB Russell Wilson’s NFL career was filled with Super Bowl glory, injuries, criticism and difficult comebacks. Through every challenge, his family remained by his side. This inspiring story explores how Ciara and their children supported Wilson during the toughest moments of his journey, including his Denver struggles, injuries and New York setbacks. The article also looks at Wilson’s rise from a third-round draft pick to a Super Bowl champion and his transition into broadcasting after retirement. A heartfelt look at the support system behind one of the NFL’s most remarkable careers.

title: Mississippi officials warn against fake Nolan Wells toxicology report
content: Mississippi Public Safety Commissioner Sean Tindell has warned that a toxicology report circulating online in connection with Nolan Wells' death is fake. Calling the document "fraudulent," Tindell urged the public to stop sharing misinformation and rely only on official updates. He also cautioned that AI and social media make it easier for false information to spread. Authorities have not released an official toxicology report, and the investigation remains ongoing.

title: Amazon market cap crosses $3 trillion as AI, cloud growth power stock rally
content: Shares of the Seattle-headquartered e-commerce and cloud giant had surged 15% on Friday after the company reported its fastest cloud revenue growth in over four years and increased its forecast for annual capital expenditure.

title: Centre raises windfall tax on petrol, diesel and ATF exports from August 3
content: India has increased export duties on petrol, diesel, and aviation fuel. These revised rates will be effective from August 3 for the next fortnight. Domestic fuel duties remain unchanged, providing stability for local consumers. This move follows a reduction in commercial LPG prices earlier this month. The government is assessing global conflicts' impact on India's supply chains.

title: India to build over 1,000 affordable homes in Seychelles
content: India will construct over one thousand affordable housing units in Seychelles. This project addresses the island nation's housing shortage and strengthens bilateral cooperation. The first phase of this development is scheduled for completion by the year 2029. India's National Buildings Construction Corporation will manage the entire project's planning and implementation. This initiative is part of a larger economic package and development partnership between the two nations.

title: Ramanand Sagar's son says Ranbir Kapoor has 'too much baggage' to play Lord Ram
content: Shiv Sagar, grandson of Ramanand Sagar, recently commented on the casting for the upcoming Ramayana film. He particularly lauded Yash as Ravan and Sai Pallavi as Sita, highlighting their deep cultural connection. However, Shiv Sagar voiced concerns about Ranbir Kapoor's ability to embody Lord Ram, citing his previous roles. Interestingly, Ranbir himself has expressed uncertainty about fitting this revered character during promotional events.

title: BJP holds Manjalpur in Gujarat, but with a much smaller victory margin
content: In a recent bypoll, the BJP claimed victory in the Manjalpur seat of Vadodara, Gujarat, with candidate Satish Patel triumphing over Congress's Bhikhabhai Rabari by a notable, though diminished, margin compared to past assembly election results. This election followed the passing of BJP MLA Yogesh Patel, highlighting a need for the party to reassess its strategies given the reduced lead in votes.

title: After Arjuna Awardee calls out Indian calendar, AICF moves to find solution
content: The All India Chess Federation (AICF) is working to hold the senior National Chess Championship in November-December 2026 after it was initially scheduled for March 2027. Following concerns raised by Grandmaster Abhijeet Gupta, the federation is in talks with stakeholders to finalise dates. AICF said a packed domestic and international calendar had forced the initial postponement.

title: TN SSLC supplementary result 2026 out: Check Class 10 marks here

They will need their exam roll number and date of birth to access results. This announcement allows successful candidates to proceed with Class 11 admissions. Original marksheets will be available from respective schools later.

title: Glide bombs: How these cheap weapons are giving Russia its battlefield edge back in Ukraine
content: The Ukraine conflict showcases new combat innovations, especially Russian glide bombs. These weapons allow strikes from safe distances, protecting aircraft from enemy defenses. Russia uses conversion kits and purpose-built munitions to leverage vast bomb stockpiles effectively. India is also developing its own glide bombs for deep strike capabilities. These advancements aim to hit targets with reduced risk to aircrew.

title: 'Abusing is not cool': Manu Bhaker's social media post goes viral

She did not mention any particular incident but spoke about the increasing use of abusive language in everyday conversations. Manu created history at the Paris Olympics 2024 by becoming the first Indian athlete in the post-Independence era to win two medals at a single Olympic Games.

title: Eyes in the sky: How India plans to detect & destroy every airborne threat before it strikes
content: India is significantly expanding its airborne surveillance fleet to bolster air defence capabilities.  New Netra Mk-1A aircraft will triple the indigenous fleet size by 2028.  The Netra Mk-2 program aims for advanced indigenous AWACS platforms by 2032.  This expansion will increase the fleet from six to eighteen aircraft.  These systems will provide comprehensive battlespace awareness and networked force capabilities.

title: Rakul Preet Singh reveals what drew her to play Shurpanakha in 'Ramayana'

The actress said she hopes audiences approach Shurpanakha's story with an open mind when the film releases, amid continued buzz around the 'Ramayana: The Introduction' trailer which dropped last week at Brahma Mahurat on July 30, 2026.

title: California woman rescued after being swept down Kern River rapids

They used a life jacket and rescue rope to bring her out of the water. The Kern County Sheriff's Office shared dramatic video footage of the successful rescue. Officials warned the public about the river's extreme dangers and the need for caution.

The J&K seamer's rise is driven by a simple philosophy: if you want to play for India, excuses are not an option.

title: Senior Russian general survives assassination attempt in Moscow restaurant blast
content: a homemade bomb exploded at an upscale restaurant in Kudrinskaya square . five people were killed and 19 others injured, according to the Daily Mail . a senior Russian general reportedly survived an apparent assassination attempt . the bomb was disguised as a gift and brought towards the restaurant by a woman .
